conviction_note: The H1 shortfall against the company plan can be worked out from public data (Q1 進捗率 42.8% against a 5-year average of 44.9%, an equity-method loss of ¥1.17bn in Q1, Sugi Pharmacy Q2 all-store sales slowing to +5.5% from +8.7%), and the street had already cut FY ordinary-profit consensus to ¥52.8bn against the ¥55.0bn plan while the stock fell about 25% from its pre-Q1 level. What this release can add is a FY revision for the Seki Yakuhin consolidation (effective 2026-09-01, impact 'under review' in the Q1 短信), and I cannot sign it. So p_up is 50 and the scaled number is 0. The findings sum to +0.2 because each finding carries its own small lean, which does not contradict the scaled 0.

Street FY OI consensus ¥52.8bn vs company ¥55.0bn as of 2026-09-24 (kabuyoho, https://kabuyoho.jp/reportNews?bcode=7649); no sourced H1 consensus. print_vs_bar_pct is my estimate of H1 OP (~¥26.0bn) against the ¥26.7bn company plan. H1 OI is likely ~8-10% under its ¥27.1bn plan because of the equity-method loss.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% (no disclosed position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 11.87 (baseline and kabutan quote page 2026-10-08). findings.finding: H1 OI will very likely land well under the ¥27.1bn company plan. Q1 OI was ¥11.59bn (+1.9%, after a ¥1.17bn equity-method loss), so Q2 needs +20.6% YoY (OP +14.2%). Sugi Pharmacy Q2 all-store sales slowed to +5.5% (Q1 +8.7%) and drugstore-merchandise existing-store sales to +0.5% (Q1 +4.5%), with prescriptions at +10.6%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 (2026-07-09, OP slightly under company plan on gross margin) fell 8.06%, but that print also carried a GIC third-party allotment (2.81% dilution) that the press named as the main driver. Last H1 (2025-10-09, OI 進捗率 48.0% vs 5y avg 50.4%, Q2 margin 5.5%->5.0%) fell 1.12% the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The 月次 are public, the Q1 shortfall was covered by Fisco on 2026-07-10, FY OI consensus fell from ¥54.06bn to ¥52.8bn in September, two brokers set Neutral targets of ¥1,300-1,390 in mid/late September, and the stock is down about 25% from before Q1. What is not public is how far the Q2 gross margin offsets the sales slowdown. If the miss were unpriced, consensus would still sit near the ¥55bn plan and the stock near 1,450.
findings.independence: Q1 progress and the equity-method loss come from the Q1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260709590143.pdf), and the street view from kabuyoho consensus (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportNews?bcode=7649). These are different documents, but all are already public.

findings.finding: The company consolidated Seki Yakuhin (51%, Saitama drugstore and pharmacy chain, reported FY3/2025 sales ¥100.5bn and OP ¥3.1bn) effective 2026-09-01, and its Q1 短信 said the FY impact was 'under review'. No 修正 has been filed since, so a FY revision is likely at this print: H2 sales up about ¥50bn, the equity-method loss replaced by consolidated OP, and a possible step-acquisition gain or loss below OI. The street's FY OI (¥52.8bn) sits under the ¥55.0bn plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY revisions on record: 25/07/10 (with Q1 FY26), 25/01/09 (Q3 FY25), 23/12/26 and 24/03/26 (directions behind kabutan's paywall). No H1-print revision in the three years visible. No sourced reaction to a revision-line surprise.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether there will be a revision, and in which direction, is unknown until the release, and the street FY consensus seems to model the organic shortfall, not a Seki-inclusive plan. If the market expected a Seki-driven upward revision, consensus would not have been cut through September. Small positive lean: a revision that holds or raises OI including Seki would beat a street that is already ¥2.2bn below plan. It could equally be an organic cut hidden inside a sales raise, hence the wide range.
findings.independence: Deal terms (49%->51%, transfer 2026-09-01, price undisclosed): Nihon M&A Center news, https://www.nihon-ma.co.jp/news/20260409_7649-49/ (2026-04-09). The Seki sales/OP figures are from a search summary of Toyo Keizai (https://toyokeizai.net/articles/-/903241), snippet_only, not confirmed in the document.

baseline_tension: Agrees with the baseline: a slightly negative priced lean (-0.26), a -5.6% 20-day run-up, a ~25% drawdown since July and street cuts all show the visible H1 shortfall is already in the price. The strongest positive the release could carry is a Seki-inclusive FY revision that holds or raises OI above the ¥52.8bn street figure (I looked; the company flagged it). A 悪材料出尽くし bounce after a known miss is also plausible. No buyback is plausible after the July equity raise.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on 月次/進捗率 the market already has): trimmed the visible-miss finding from -0.3 to -0.2 and moved p_up from 48 to 50, so expected_move goes from -0.12 to 0.0
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive (a Seki-inclusive revision above street, 出尽くし) into baseline_tension. I had already searched for it, so nothing further moved
Left standing: the Seki guidance finding at +0.3 and the Tsuruha peer finding at +0.1; abs_move_pct 3.0
